tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: A ball is dropped from a height of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>. If the coefficient of restitution for the collision between ball and floor is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn></math>, after hitting the floor, the ball rebounds to a height of ______ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>.

solution.text:
As we know h'=e2h, where h'=height after the collision, h=height before the collision and e=coefficient of restitution.

Therefore,

h'=0.52×20 m=5 m
